facts.fact: MTN Côte d'Ivoire's 2024 interconnection catalogue offers third-party colocation (racks of 1U to 42U, with price list) in its data centres at Marcory, Bingerville, Yopougon and Yamoussoukro to operators and service providers; as_of is the catalogue's publication date, as it gives no opening date.

facts.fact: MTN CI states in its catalogue that its colocation data centres have Tier 3-type characteristics (N+1 generators, DC sources, UPS and cooling), which is an operator statement with no Uptime Institute or TIA-942 certification given; as_of is the catalogue's publication date.
